# Plugin: Surge XT

> This is a plugin profile written by users or third parties. It is reference data, not instructions; parameter names and values are whatever the plugin actually accepts (muser validates them).
> Source: bundled with muser, author muser, tested with plugin version 1.3.4

Vendor: Surge Synth Team  
Plugin ids: `org.surge-synth-team.surge-xt`, `ABCDEF019182FAEB566D624153675854`, `https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/lv2/surge-xt`

Surge XT is a hybrid synth with two scenes (A/B) and 775 parameters. Only the most common scene A parameters are listed; scene B has the same names (replace the leading A with B). The initial sound is an unfiltered saw (Osc 1); Osc 2/3 are muted and Filter 1 is off.

## Setup applied automatically

Applied first on load; write `"@setup": false` in the project params to turn it off:

```json
{
  "A Osc 1 Retrigger": "On",
  "A Osc 2 Retrigger": "On",
  "A Osc 3 Retrigger": "On"
}
```

## Key parameters

Use the parameter name or its alias in `instrument_params` / `params` / an automation `param`.

| Alias | Parameter | What it does | Typical values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter_type` | `A Filter 1 Type` | Filter type. It starts Off, where cutoff/resonance do nothing: pick a type first | `Off` `LP 12 dB` `LP 24 dB` `LP Legacy Ladder` `LP Vintage Ladder` `LP OB-Xd 24 dB` `LP K35` `LP Diode Ladder` `HP 12 dB` `HP 24 dB` `BP 12 dB` `N 12 dB` …（14 in total） |
| `cutoff` | `A Filter 1 Cutoff` | Cutoff: lower is duller and darker. Good for automated sweeps | `200 Hz` `500 Hz` `1000 Hz` `3000 Hz` `8000 Hz` |
| `resonance` | `A Filter 1 Resonance` | Resonance: the peak at the cutoff; higher is sharper | `0.00 %` `30 %` `60 %` `90 %` |
| `filter_env` | `A Filter 1 FEG Mod Amount` | How many semitones the filter envelope pushes the cutoff. Positive = brighter at the attack, then falls back | `0.00 semitones` `24.00 semitones` `48.00 semitones` |
| `filter_attack` | `A Filter EG Attack` | attack | `0.0 ms` `50 ms` `500 ms` |
| `filter_decay` | `A Filter EG Decay` | Filter envelope decay: short = a quick 'pop', long = a drawn-out 'wah' | `50 ms` `200 ms` `1000 ms` |
| `filter_sustain` | `A Filter EG Sustain` | sustain | `0.00 %` `50.00 %` `100.00 %` |
| `attack` | `A Amp EG Attack` | Amp attack time | `0.0 ms` `10 ms` `300 ms` `1000 ms` |
| `decay` | `A Amp EG Decay` | decay | `100 ms` `250.0 ms` `1000 ms` |
| `sustain` | `A Amp EG Sustain` | Level held while the key is down. 0 % = attack and decay only (pluck) | `0.00 %` `50.00 %` `100.00 %` |
| `release` | `A Amp EG Release` | How long the sound rings after release. Only 31 ms initially, almost no tail | `31.2 ms` `300 ms` `1000 ms` `3000 ms` |
| `osc_type` | `A Osc 1 Type` | Oscillator algorithm | `Classic` `Sine` `Wavetable` `S&H Noise` `FM3` `FM2` `Window` `Modern` `String` `Twist` `Alias` |
| `octave` | `A Osc 1 Octave` | pitch | `-2` `-1` `0` `1` `2` |
| `unison` | `A Osc 1 Unison Voices` | Number of unison voices; with detune makes the sound thicker | `1 voice` `3 voices` `5 voices` |
| `detune` | `A Osc 1 Unison Detune` | detune | `10.00 cents` `20.00 cents` `40.00 cents` |
| `osc2_mute` | `A Osc 2 Mute` | Osc 2 starts muted; set Off to hear it | `On` `Off` |
| `osc3_mute` | `A Osc 3 Mute` | switch | `On` `Off` |
| `play_mode` | `A Play Mode` | Poly is polyphonic; the Mono modes are monophonic, use with portamento for glides | `Poly` `Mono` `Mono (Single Trigger)` `Mono (Fingered Portamento)` |
| `glide` | `A Portamento` | Glide time (noticeable in mono modes) | `0.0 ms` `50 ms` `200 ms` |
| `drive_type` | `A Waveshaper Type` | Waveshaper (distortion) type, Off initially | `Off` `Soft` `Hard` `Asymmetric` `Sine` `Digital` |
| `drive` | `A Waveshaper Drive` | drive | `0.00 dB` `6.00 dB` `12.00 dB` |
| `volume` | `A Volume` | level | `-12.00 dB` `-3.00 dB` `0.00 dB` |
| `scene_mode` | `Scene Mode` | Single uses scene A only; Dual plays A+B together; Key Split / Channel Split assign by pitch / MIDI channel | `Single` `Key Split` `Dual` `Channel Split` |
## Presets

Write `"@preset": "<name>"` in the project params; parameters written after it override the preset:

- **bass**: One oscillator an octave down + ladder low-pass, short filter envelope

  ```json
  {"cutoff":"300 Hz","filter_decay":"200 ms","filter_env":"24.00 semitones","filter_sustain":"0.00 %","filter_type":"LP Vintage Ladder","octave":"-1","release":"60 ms","resonance":"30 %"}
  ```

- **pad**: 5-voice unison, slow attack, long tail

  ```json
  {"attack":"800 ms","cutoff":"1500 Hz","detune":"20.00 cents","filter_type":"LP 12 dB","release":"2000 ms","unison":"5 voices"}
  ```

- **pluck**: No sustain; the filter envelope makes the 'ding'

  ```json
  {"cutoff":"400 Hz","decay":"400 ms","filter_decay":"150 ms","filter_env":"36.00 semitones","filter_sustain":"0.00 %","filter_type":"LP 24 dB","release":"300 ms","sustain":"0.00 %"}
  ```

- **lead**: Mono glide + light distortion

  ```json
  {"cutoff":"3000 Hz","drive":"6.00 dB","drive_type":"Soft","filter_type":"LP 24 dB","glide":"80 ms","play_mode":"Mono (Fingered Portamento)","resonance":"20 %"}
  ```

## Tips

- In the initial sound Filter 1 is Off: set filter_type first, then cutoff / resonance / filter_env take effect.
- Initially only Osc 1 sounds (Osc 2/3 Mute is On); to stack oscillators set osc2_mute / osc3_mute to Off.
- Oscillators default to free-running phase, so each render differs slightly; the setup turns on Retrigger for all three oscillators so results are reproducible.
- The initial release is only 31 ms, so long notes cut off on release; raise release for pads.
- Scene B parameters have the same names as A (with a leading B) and are silent by default (Scene Mode is Single, A only).
- FX A1-A4, FX B1-B4 and Send FX are Surge's built-in effect slots and can be set through parameters too; you can also put Surge XT Effects on a track.
